card.name: Time units in dosing schedules
card.fires_on: The time unit or linking word right after an interval in a dosing or monitoring schedule, such as 'every 4 weeks', 'every 6 hours' or 'then monthly'.

modes.label: Unit after 'every N'
modes.description: The time unit (weeks, hours) right after 'every' and a number in a dose or test schedule.
modes.example: then 80 mg every 4<< weeks>>. 2.3 Recommended Dosage

modes.label: Then or comma in a sequence
modes.description: A word like 'then' or a comma that moves to the next step in a staged monitoring or dosing plan.
modes.example: during the first month of treatment,<< then>> monthly thereafter, and as clinically indicated.
